messages:
Riley Gomez: Heads-up: several mobile-submitted scorecards didn't attach for the IC hiring loop this AM. Interviewers see 'submitted' in app but candidate pages show no attachment. Can someone triage? :grimacing:

Recruiter Bot: Webhook summary 2026-08-02: deliveries=18, failures=4 (422). Endpoint: /webhooks/mobile-submissions. Logs: https://logs.redwood/webhooks/2026-08-02

Jules Becker: Found the problem: prod mapping expects 'scorecard' but the mobile client still posts 'sc_card' after the refactor. I'll patch the proxy to accept both keys; will roll in ~10m.

Priya S: While patching happens, recruiters need a workaround. Can we add an 'attach mobile submission' button on candidate view so they can attach payloads without asking interviewers to re-submit? Also: please send a short note to interviewers who submitted during the window.

Emily (People Ops): I'll draft a one-paragraph email for #hiring-toolkit and create a short FAQ entry. Suggested line: "If you submitted between 08:00-11:00 UTC, please re-open the mobile submission and re-submit or notify your recruiter."

Jules Becker: Patch deployed. Triggering a backfill job to reprocess failed deliveries now: POST /internal/webhooks/reprocess {source:mobile-submissions, from:2026-08-02T07:00Z, to:2026-08-02T12:00Z}.

Recruiter Bot: Reprocess job started: job_20260802_reproc_12.

Jules Becker: Reprocess done: 4 reprocessed, 3 scorecards attached automatically, 1 missing file (uploader cancelled) -> flagged for manual follow-up. Job: https://internal.jobs/job_20260802_reproc_12

Priya S: I'll contact the interviewer for the one missing file. Emily: please schedule a 20-min calibration refresh for frequent interviewers; two slots (EMEA + US) and record it. Include a 3-question micro-quiz in the invite.

Emily (People Ops): On it. Also filing frontend ticket INT-4720 for a small banner on candidate pages when completed_at is set but no scorecard: "Scorecard missing  recruiter action required." Adding monitoring alert for webhook 4xx spikes.

Riley Gomez: Thanks all for the quick fix. Closing loop once training invites + ticket are live. :white_check_mark:
